selectProject: Select a project from the sidebar to open a terminal
restoreFailedHint: Check the terminal output for details
coldRestoreHint: This terminal backend is too old to safely adopt the running terminal. End the old terminal and restore the session with its previous configuration.
coldRestoreFailed: The old terminal could not be ended, so no replacement was started. Retry or handle the old session in the resource manager.

restoreBlocked.claims-unsupported: This terminal backend cannot negotiate safe claims. Automatic recreation stopped; end the old terminal to restore it manually.
restoreBlocked.reconciliation-failed: Daemon session ownership could not be verified. Automatic recreation was stopped.
restoreBlocked.missing-provenance: This session lacks complete birth evidence and can only be adopted manually.
restoreBlocked.identity-mismatch: The session identity does not match this terminal leaf. See the restore log below for which check failed.
restoreBlocked.anchorless-session: This session's birth evidence has no pane anchor (usually created by an older version), so it is not adopted automatically — you can adopt it below.
restoreBlocked.attach-rejected: Identity checks passed, but the session could not be attached to this pane (layout mismatch, the leaf is occupied, or the terminal is already mounted elsewhere).
restoreBlocked.ambiguous-candidates: Multiple live sessions match this terminal leaf, so none was selected automatically.
restoreBlocked.claim-conflict: Another CC-Panes instance currently owns this session.
restoreBlocked.auto-adopt-disabled: Automatic adoption is disabled. The session can be adopted from the resource manager.

manualAdopt.not-found: No archive record for this session; it may have already ended.
manualAdopt.claim-failed: Another instance currently owns this session (its write lease expires in 30s — try again shortly).
manualAdopt.attach-failed: Could not attach to this pane: the project path does not match, the leaf is occupied, or the terminal is already mounted elsewhere.
